items.title: Stable US Large Cap Stocks to Watch as Recession Risks Rise
items.summary: Markets look calm on the surface, yet warnings about a harsher future recession, heavy AI-related borrowing and a softer labor backdrop suggest this comfort may not last. That mix can reward investors who focus on sturdier large caps, even as many others chase the loudest AI story. This article walks through three quality U.S. stocks exposed to these trends and explains why each could matter for your portfolio decisions today.
